items.title: Albert Glenny Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Wellman Brog? Wellman Brog? Blown. Big tall old man.

ctx.x: Cuoco? Cuoco! Tip He was here the other day. He came from California. He used to live on Debonay in the North East for years before he went to California. A big starboard man. He played Bates. Wellman Brog? Wellman Brog? Blown. Big tall old man.
